name: Toby Genkel
bio: Toby Genkel is a German-born British film director and animator. Together with Reza Memari, he directed Richard The Stork (2017). He is also known for directing the films Two Times Lotte (2007), Ooops! Noah Is Gone (2015), Welcome to Smelliville (2021), The Amazing Maurice (2022) and High in the Clouds (2027), as well as co-directing Stitch Head (2025).
